description: This file defines the FetchedResultsNotesObserver class, which observes changes in Core Data's NoteEntity objects, filters based on a query, and triggers a callback with the domain Note objects upon data changes.

classes.name: FetchedResultsNotesObserver
classes.description: A delegate class that observes NSFetchedResultsController updates for NoteEntity objects and invokes a callback with domain Note objects when data changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the fetched results controller with an optional query filter and performs an initial fetch.

methods.name: controllerDidChangeContent
methods.description: Delegate method called when the fetched results controller detects data changes, triggering the onChange callback.
